name: com.nmj_gd.nmjtoolbox
description:
Helper scripts, runtime extensions and Editor tooling for Unity.

Runtime: inspector-driven object pooling built on UnityEngine.Pool, collection/string/vector/math/UI Toolkit extension methods, gizmo shapes Unity does not ship, a MonoBehaviour singleton base, a small state machine and a scene-path based SceneChanger.

Editor: a one-click project setup that installs, removes and imports a whole package set in a single transaction from a committed profile asset; batch rename with {token} expressions for the Hierarchy and Project window; Create/Dissolve Collection grouping; Mini Hierarchy, Inspector, Selection History and Isolate overlays for the Scene view; a state machine code generator; a project folder-structure scaffolder; a material builder driven by texture filename conventions; prefab and build tools; AssetDatabase helpers; a grid instantiator; and a component context-menu GameObject renamer.
